lines.text: The LORD announces one more plague, after which Pharaoh will drive Israel out, and the people ask neighbors for silver and gold.
Moses says that about midnight every firstborn in Egypt will die, but not even a dog will snarl at Israel.
On the tenth day each household selects an unblemished year-old male lamb and keeps it until the fourth day of the month.
They put the lamb's blood on the doorframes and eat the meat roasted with unleavened bread and bitter herbs, and the LORD passes over them.
Moses tells the elders to dip a cluster of cedar into the blood and brush it on the doorframe.
